labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in CONTRIBUTING.md (AI_POLICY.md points to master).

body:
Thanks for spotting this. The link to `AI_POLICY.md` in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) (line 9) points to the `master` branch, so it can break. Pull requests are limited to collaborators, so this issue is the place to describe the link fix. A maintainer will review it there.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
